name: detect_workday_wd_locale_site
spec_quote: workday: `https://<tenant>.wd<N>.myworkdayjobs.com/[<locale like en-US>/]<site>/...` → ident = [host, tenant, site] (host lower-case, e.g. "acme.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com", tenant = first host label, site = first path part that is not a locale).

name: detect_workday_wday_path_ignored
spec_quote: A Workday URL with no site part (just the host, or the path starts with "wday" or "job") is ignored.

name: detect_greenhouse_embed_for_token
spec_quote: greenhouse: `boards.greenhouse.io/<token>`, `job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>`, `boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_board?for=<token>`, `boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<token>` → ident = token (case kept).
why: The explicitly listed embed form uses 'embed' as a path segment, but 'embed' is also listed among the tokens that 'are not boards → ignored'; the spec does not say which rule wins for the embed URL.

name: detect_greenhouse_stopword_token_ignored
spec_quote: Tokens "embed", "jobs", "v1", "boards", "api", "www", "static", "assets", "js", "css", "search" (any case) are not boards → ignored.

name: detect_multi_system_order_and_host_case
spec_quote: Result order: by system in this fixed order: workday, greenhouse, lever, ashby, icims, oraclecloud, successfactors, taleo, smartrecruiters, workable, ... icims: host `<x>.icims.com` → ident = that host, lower-case. ... smartrecruiters: `jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<slug>` or `careers.smartrecruiters.com/<slug>` → slug lower-case.

name: names_boozallen_label_inside_key
spec_quote: Passes if some distinctive word of ≥ 3 letters is inside the label, or the label is inside the company key squashed (lower-case, suffixes removed, all non-alphanumerics removed), or the label equals the initials of the company key's words.

name: names_linkedin_redirect_guard
spec_quote: Otherwise → false (e.g. a guessed domain that redirected to linkedin.com or a domain-parking site).

name: names_no_distinctive_words

args.page: <html><head><title>International Health Systems</title><meta property="og:site_name" content="International Health Systems"></head></html>

spec_quote: then generic words dropped: ... services, solutions, systems, international, global, national, american, america, ... health, bank, ...; and one-letter words dropped. No distinctive words left → false.

name: names_og_site_name_squashed_match
spec_quote: 2. Name check on the page's `<title>` plus `og:site_name` content (HTML entities decoded, lower-case): true if the distinctive words joined with no spaces appear inside that text with all non-alphanumerics removed

name: names_first_two_words_rule
spec_quote: otherwise true only if EVERY one of the first two distinctive words appears as a whole word in the text.

name: challenge_title_just_a_moment

args.page: <html><head><title>Just a moment...</title></head><body>Checking your browser before accessing.</body></html>

spec_quote: True if the page `<title>` begins with "Just a moment", "Attention Required", "Access Denied" or "Security check" (any case, any status).

name: challenge_captcha_only_in_body_200

args.page: Please complete the captcha to submit your application.

spec_quote: A 200 page that merely mentions "captcha" in its body (no such title) → false.

name: challenge_429_cf_chl
spec_quote: Also true if status is 403, 429 or 503 and the first 20,000 characters contain any of: "just a moment...", "cf-chl", "challenge-platform", "attention required", "captcha", "are you a robot", "access denied", "perimeterx", "px-captcha", "_incapsula_".

name: challenge_404_access_denied_body
spec_quote: A 404 → false.

name: norm_fulltime_remote_suffix
spec_quote: Removes "(Full-Time)", ... (any case), the words ... ; a trailing " - Remote" / " - Hybrid" / " - United States"; ... collapses spaces.

name: norm_city_tail_dash
spec_quote: then a trailing city tail " - <City>, <ST>" or ", <City>, <ST>" (ST = two capital letters); collapses spaces.

name: norm_city_tail_comma
spec_quote: then a trailing city tail " - <City>, <ST>" or ", <City>, <ST>" (ST = two capital letters); collapses spaces.

name: city_plus_n
spec_quote: "New York, NY + 2" → "new york".

name: city_remote_or
spec_quote: "Remote or Freeport, IL + 8" → "freeport".

name: city_drop_word_city
spec_quote: "New York City, NY" → "new york".

name: match_duplicate_urls_same_posting
spec_quote: All postings with the best score share one URL → that posting, unless: the row has a city (city_of(location) non-empty), ...

name: match_below_floor
spec_quote: Best similarity < 0.75 (or no postings) → null.

name: match_same_title_other_city_null
spec_quote: unless: the row has a city (city_of(location) non-empty), the posting location is non-empty, the posting location does not contain the city, the posting location does not say "<N> Locations", "remote", "multiple", "united states", "nationwide" or equal "us", and the row's title does not contain the city → null (same title in another city = a different opening).

name: match_n_locations_exception
spec_quote: the posting location does not say "<N> Locations", "remote", "multiple", "united states", "nationwide" or equal "us", ... → null

name: match_tie_broken_by_city
spec_quote: Several postings tie on the best score with different URLs → the single one whose location contains the row's city; none, or more than one with different URLs → null.

name: decide_already_has_ats_url
spec_quote: row has a non-empty ats_url → code "already".
why: The spec defines only the code for this branch; it does not say what `system` (or why) must be returned, so only the code is asserted.

name: decide_no_system
spec_quote: systems empty → code "no_system", system "".

name: decide_match_greenhouse
spec_quote: Try each searchable system (workday, greenhouse, lever, ashby) in the given order; postings_of(system, ident, title) gives postings; the first match_posting hit → code "match", ats_url = the posting URL, system = that system.

name: decide_no_match_reports_first_searchable
spec_quote: Searchable systems present but no hit → code "no_match", system = first searchable system.

name: decide_other_system_only_non_searchable
spec_quote: Only non-searchable systems (icims, taleo, …) → code "other_system", system = the first system in the list; no ats_url.
